problem_card.title: Certified Euclidean algorithm and Bézout witness exemplar
problem_card.normalized_statement: For natural numbers a and b, not both zero, a valid certificate reports a positive natural d, a complete Euclidean division trace ending in zero, and integers x and y satisfying x*a + y*b = d. The certification stage must prove that every accepted certificate has d = Nat.gcd a b.

object_certificate_separation.sought_object: the greatest common divisor d of a and b
object_certificate_separation.witness: integer Bézout coefficients x and y
object_certificate_separation.certificate: provider-bound JSON containing inputs, full trace, d, x, y, and claim scope

source_map.support_scope: historical context only; does not support attribution of the modern extended-Euclidean or integer Bézout statement to Euclid

failure_risks.summary: A quotient or remainder may be altered while retaining a plausible-looking trace.
The remainder sequence may fail strict descent.
failure_risks.required_rejection: require 0 <= r < divisor before the terminal step

failure_risks.summary: A trace may be truncated before terminal zero.
failure_risks.required_rejection: require the terminal remainder to be zero

failure_risks.summary: The reported divisor may not equal the last positive remainder.
failure_risks.required_rejection: bind d to the terminal positive divisor

failure_risks.summary: Bézout coefficients may be changed independently of the trace.
Inputs may be substituted after witness generation.
failure_risks.required_rejection: bind the certificate to exact inputs and provider identities

failure_risks.summary: The undefined normalization case (0,0) may be silently widened.
A negative or zero d may be accepted as normalized gcd.
Candidate computation may be mislabeled as certification.
failure_risks.required_rejection: retain candidate_only authority until MATHCERT disposition

failure_risks.summary: Modern Bézout language may be falsely attributed verbatim to Euclid.
failure_risks.required_rejection: require exact historical-modern concordance before documentary attribution

suggested_wp01.objective: implement deterministic extended Euclid and emit the exact candidate certificate

certification_route_sketch.independence_requirement: checker must not import or execute the MATHSOLVE producer

chaidez_documentary_contract.opening: begin with gcd(252,105) and the three exact divisions

claim_boundary.statement: This Forge package fixes the modern target, concrete candidate evidence, risks, and downstream contract. It does not certify the gcd, the trace, the Bézout witness, any historical equivalence, novelty, or priority.
